title: FEATURE — SCS-001 pipeline heartbeat: Telegram alert if no pipeline run in 6h
rationale: The 15-stage pipeline runs every 3h (06:00/09:00/11:00 confirmed from pipeline-runs/). If the pipeline stops (PM2 crash, ffmpeg hang, model timeout), there is currently no alert. Build pipeline-heartbeat.ts: reads reports/pipeline-runs/latest.json, checks if last run was > 6h ago, sends Telegram alert to OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID if stale. Wire into PM2 (every 30 min via cron_restart). Closes the blind-spot where the pipeline silently stops producing videos.
success_criteria: pipeline-heartbeat.ts --check runs dry and reports last run age
Telegram message sent when last run is simulated as > 6h old
PM2 job added to ecosystem.config.js with cron every 30 min

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/pipeline-heartbeat.ts: reads reports/pipeline-runs/latest.json, computes hours since last run, sends Telegram alert via bot API if > STALE_THRESHOLD_H (default 6). Logs to logs/heartbeat/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. --check flag for dry-run.
ecosystem.config.js: add scs001-heartbeat PM2 job — runs pipeline-heartbeat.ts every 30 min via cron_restart '*/30 * * * *'. Include LOG_PREFIX, STALE_THRESHOLD_H env.
